FN-N3ZBT8-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 163
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/17/2023
Senate Bill 163as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of counties,
municipalities, or governmental entities subject to a countywide civil service system that elect,
by a majority vote of the county commission, city or town council, or governmental entity, to
opt out of the countywide civil service system to establish a separate program for the
recruitment, testing, interviewing, and hiring of all employees.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 163
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Government
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/22/2023
Senate Bill 163 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of counties,
municipalities, or governmental entities subject to a countywide civil service system that elect,
to opt-out of the countywide civil service system to adopt a human resources policy and
procedures manual.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
